bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Builds Released - New builds for Canary, Dev, and Beta Channels enhance user experience and features.
Windows 11, version 25H2 Available - The latest feature update is now in the Release Preview Channel ahead of general availability.
Microsoft Defender Leads Endpoint Security - Ranked number one in modern endpoint security market share for the third consecutive year.
Storm-0501 Adapts to Cloud Ransomware - Evolving tactics highlight the need for enhanced security in cloud environments.
Securing Autonomous Agents - New governance strategies are essential as the number of autonomous agents may surpass human users by 2026.
